summary: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region instead of zero tax, and its return type becomes int | None.

findings.title: None return breaks both callers for unknown regions
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total adds the result to an int, and tax_line divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout and receipt printing raise TypeError for every order from an unlisted region. Those customers can no longer complete a purchase.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions. Alternatively, update order_total and tax_line in the same change to handle None.

findings.title: Changed unknown-region behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The repository contains no test that calls tax_for with an unknown region. No test covers the new None branch either.
findings.consequence: Nothing catches the caller breakage this change introduces. Later regressions in tax_for also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with a known region and an unknown region.
